lines.zh: 红壳上七颗黑点，很显眼
lines.en: Seven black spots on my red shell, hard to miss
Six legs find a path across the petals
The meadow is full of flowers, I visit each
My shell opens and the wings come out

lines.zh: 我从一片花瓣走到另一片
lines.en: I walk from one petal to the next

lines.zh: 花林里我的颜色最扎眼
lines.en: In the flower woods my color stands out most

lines.zh: 圆墩墩的身子，走起来晃
lines.en: A round body, and I wobble as I go
I climb up the stem
There is pollen on my shell

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，反正花不会跑
lines.en: I go slowly, the flowers will not run

lines.zh: 脚下是软的，花心有点甜
lines.en: The footing is soft, and the flower heart is sweet
The sun is good, so I take a turn outside
I slid one step on the petal
The scent of the flower pulled me here

lines.zh: 我绕着一朵花走了半圈
lines.en: I walk half a circle around a flower
My red shell shines in the sun
I rest in the flower's heart, sunning
Shell closed, legs tucked under
The flower's heart is warm and fragrant
I stay still like a bead
My antennae sway, soft and slow
The wind on the meadow is soft
My shadow is small and round
I wait for the sun to climb a little

lines.zh: 有只蜂飞过去了，我不理
lines.en: A bee flew past, I ignore it
Pollen settles on my back, I leave it
This flower is mine
I crawl two steps and stop again

lines.zh: 你这么大一坨，我在花上
lines.en: You are a heap this big, and I am on a flower
I lift my head and point my antennae at you

lines.zh: 红壳上的点，你数得清吗
lines.en: Can you count the spots on my shell
Do not pinch me, the shell cracks
I back off to the petal's edge
Are you here picking flowers
Round as I am, I roll away fast

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我的花枝晃了晃。
lines.en: You crouch down and my flower stem sways.

lines.zh: 我给花传粉，花给我住处
lines.en: I pollinate the flowers, they give me shelter
Come closer and I fly
A crack in my shell
I rolled to one side
I tipped over and cannot right myself
The pain makes my wings tremble
You would hit a bug this small
My crawling slowed
I draw every leg into the shell
Three legs on this side are numb
I land on a grass blade and recover
With this wound I can still fly
That in your hand, is it sweet
I take two steps and stop
Nectar is enough, do not trouble yourself
I sniff it, not quite sure
Hold your hand still, let me look
This is more fragrant than a flower's heart
I climbed on and stood a while
Too much, I cannot finish it
I lick it once, just once
Your palm is too warm
One bump and I roll twice
My shell hit the stone

lines.zh: 你这么重，我一朵花都站不住
lines.en: You are so heavy, I cannot hold on to a flower
You carried me far off
I flipped over and my legs are waving
I climb back onto the petal
Do not step, I am right by your foot

lines.zh: 这一下，我壳上多了个印
lines.en: That left a mark on my shell

lines.zh: 你一脚踩偏，我滚到花瓣下。
lines.en: Your foot lands wide and I roll under the petals.
A round body is not sturdy
There are plenty of my kind in the meadow

lines.zh: 我在叶子上留了点味道
lines.en: I left a little scent on the leaf
The spots on the shell, that is what one looks at

lines.zh: 我走了一圈，没找到合适的
lines.en: I walked a circle and found none suitable
Where flowers are many, meetings happen

lines.zh: 我们飞起来会撞在一起
lines.en: We tend to bump when we fly

lines.zh: 这种事不急，我还有花期
lines.en: No rush, there is still the blooming season
I came close and looked a while
There is time before the sun sets
I am off, next flower
I crawl to the leaf edge
I hug it with my front legs
Red like me, but it is not mine
I push it rolling a short way
A shell this hard, I cannot chew it
I balance it on my head
There is no room for this on the flower
I look at it and set it down
My legs are not strong enough
It landed beside me, let me sniff first
Something is approaching the flowers
I lift my head and see it
A small bug like me can only watch first
I retreat behind the petal
My wings are ready under the shell
Wrong position, I need to shift
I fix on that shadow
This close, I cannot run far
I have pressed myself lower
The stem is moving, that is it
I am ready to drop off
Do not come over, I have wings
I crawl down the stem pressed flat
Petals and leaves are my cover
I watch and do not fly
When it moves, I freeze

lines.zh: 红壳太显眼，我往叶背躲
lines.en: The red shell is too bright, I hide under the leaf
This flower is too low
I count how many steps away it is
Wait for it to walk off
My wings are half open
I climb up a little more
At this distance it cannot reach me
Move again and I drop off
I bump it with my body
A shell butt, very light
I bit, and it did nothing
I flung myself at its hand
All six legs grip

lines.zh: 这点力气，我自己都知道小
lines.en: This little force, I know it is small
I hit once and drop away
There is pollen on your hand now
I crawl between your fingers
Strike, then fly off
A red speck has appeared on the meadow
I crawl out of the flower's heart
The flower woods have just enough sun
I open my shell and dry my wings

lines.zh: 我落在花瓣上，晃了一下
lines.en: I land on the petal and wobble
A flower just opened, and I arrived
There is sweetness in the air
I take off from this leaf
The wind blew me onto a flower
I shake myself and my shell reddens

lines.zh: 热气钻进壳缝，我缩起六条腿。
lines.en: Heat seeps through the seam of my shell; I tuck in all six legs.

lines.zh: 我从花上摔下去，壳先着地
lines.en: I fell from the flower, shell first
Water has got in through the seam
The blast threw me into the air

lines.zh: 一支箭擦过，把我弹出老远
lines.en: An arrow grazed past and knocked me far
A chill crept into the crack in my shell
The flowers have stopped giving nectar
A flash of lightning and my legs went stiff
It is empty here, no flowers
